title: acer japonicum f. aureum
intro: Acer japonicum f. aureum, commonly known as Full Moon Maple or Golden Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Japan and Korea. It is known for its beautiful, palmate leaves with 7-9 lobes and golden-yellow variegation. The Full Moon Maple has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fever, as well as its therapeutic actions, such as sedation and relaxation. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
